Toku combines local strategic consulting expertise, bespoke technology, regional infrastructure, connectivity, and global reach to serve enterprises operating at scale across APAC and beyond.
 



  





 As a Senior Backend Engineer, you will play a backend\\-first technical role designing, building and operating the distributed systems that power Toku's communications platform. Successful candidates may join one of several backend engineering squads depending on their technical strengths, experience and current business priorities, contributing to customer\\-facing platform capabilities, backend services, integrations, and shared engineering infrastructure.
 



  





 You will work primarily in Go, building scalable distributed systems, backend integrations, cloud\\-native services and production\\-critical communication infrastructure. This role places a strong emphasis on backend engineering depth, architecture, distributed systems thinking, production ownership and technical initiative.

* **Backend services \\& APIs:** 
 Design, build and evolve robust backend services and APIs that power Toku's cloud communications platform.

 Design and develop scalable distributed systems and microservices, making sound architectural decisions around service boundaries, scalability, reliability, latency, fault tolerance and operational simplicity.

* **Backend engineering:** 
 Strong hands\\-on experience designing, building and operating production backend systems. Engineering depth and ownership are valued more than strict years of experience.
* **Go (Golang):** 
 Strong practical experience developing production backend services in Go.
* **Distributed systems:** 
 Experience designing or operating distributed systems, microservices and backend architectures, with an understanding of scalability, latency, resilience, fault tolerance and system trade\\-offs.
* **Event\\-driven architectures:**

* **Architecture \\& ownership:**

* **Observability:**

* **Location:**
